Water Lock engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume swim-ready features in the app cover storefront language. watchOS Control Center, crown lock, and App Store Connect actually separate on-device Water Lock behavior from product-page copy:

  • Control Center water-drop toggle — quick Water Lock on/off from Apple Watch Control Center. zh-Hans watchOS labels the tile 水下锁定. Does not generate Chinese listing text by itself.
  • Locked screen and Digital Crown — while Water Lock is on, touch and crown input stay disabled so pool splashes do not scroll or tap. Listing copy may show this locked state on screenshots; teaching buyers why crown lock matters is listing work, not engineering.
  • Water eject on unlock — turning Water Lock off triggers a speaker tone to clear water. Gallery frames may highlight Eject water or 排出水分 on post-swim education frames.
  • Swim workout sessions — Pool Swim or Open Water Swim in the Workout app may auto-enable Water Lock on supported models. Your description may mention that behavior; implementing swim metrics is engineering — distinct from zh-Hans caption lines.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Water Lock features in the binary.

A working swim or Water Lock story on device and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

FAQ

What is Apple Watch Water Lock and where do swimmers turn it on?

Water Lock locks the Apple Watch screen and Digital Crown during swimming and water sports. Swimmers enable it from Control Center on Apple Watch by tapping the water-drop icon. Turning Water Lock off plays a tone to eject water from the speaker. Simplified Chinese watchOS labels it 水下锁定.

Does a swim workout app auto-translate Water Lock marketing on the China listing?

No. Swim metrics and pool tracking in the binary control in-app behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is Water Lock different from water resistance marketing?

Water resistance marketing covers hardware depth ratings — WR50, swim-proof, 50米防水. Water Lock marketing covers the software toggle that locks touch and crown input and ejects water on unlock — 水下锁定. Hardware badges alone do not teach buyers to enable Water Lock.

How is Water Lock different from Watch Faces, Mirroring, AOD, and Unlock with Watch?

Watch Faces covers face gallery browsing — 表盘图库. Watch Mirroring covers 手表镜像 on iPhone. AOD covers dimmed always-on glances — 全天候显示. Unlock with Watch covers mask unlock — 用 Apple Watch 解锁. Water Lock covers swimming crown lock and water eject — 水下锁定.

How is Water Lock different from Watch Complications and iPhone Control Center?

Complications marketing covers watch face slot badges. iPhone Control Center marketing covers the iPhone quick-settings panel — 控制中心. Water Lock is the water-drop toggle on Apple Watch Control Center — 水下锁定 on the watch, not complication slots or iPhone controls.

How is Water Lock different from Focus, Theater Mode, and Silent Mode?

Focus silences notifications — 专注模式. Theater Mode and Silent Mode are separate watchOS toggles for cinema dimming and mute — not crown lock during swimming. Water Lock disables touch and crown input for water sports and ejects water on unlock.
